product_metadata.title: Main + Mesa Stoneware Taper Candle Holders, Set of 3
features: Set of 3 stoneware taper candle holders
Matte terracotta finish with embossed cross hatch texture
Use on a mantel or tablescape to create a dramatic scene
Small: 4.5" x 3" | Medium: 6" x 2.5" | Large: 5.5" x 5.25"
description: These stoneware candle holders will give your elegant taper candles a distinctive place to shine. In a matte terracotta finish and embossed cross hatch texture, these pieces are perfect for setting a warm glow in your home. Offered in a set of 3, each candle holder has an opening for a standard taper.
